sources.title: empero-ai/Qwen3.8-4B-Distill · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-4B is a full-parameter distillation of Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B into the Qwen3.5-4B architecture. The student was trained on ~45,000 curated teacher traces from our internal Qwen3.8 distillation datasets — dense chain-of-thought spanning mathematics, general reasoning, and instruction following, quality-filtered before training.
